english_paragraphs: In November 1983 a 15-year-old girl was murdered in the Leicestershire village of Narborough, and the homicide went unsolved. In the summer of 1986 a second 15-year-old was slain near neighbouring Enderby. A 17-year-old local youth confessed to the second killing, and to detectives the perplexing investigation was seemingly resolved.

The revelation had come two years previously. On 10 September 1984 Alec Jeffreys, a geneticist at the University of Leicester, discerned on an X-ray film molecular markers whose layout varied considerably from person to person. He called them DNA fingerprints, since, like fingerprints, they differentiated individuals. The journal Nature promptly carried his paper in March 1985.

Police enlisted Jeffreys, and his genetic tests overturned the erroneous confession. The youth was not the perpetrator, and the same attacker had killed both girls. The youth became the first person known to be cleared by DNA evidence. The forensic innovation had freed an innocent before it implicated anyone.

In January 1987 police commenced the world's first large-scale DNA screening, asking more than 5,000 men in three villages for blood or saliva. None matched. The elusive killer, a local baker, had induced a co-worker to give a sample in his name, evading suspicion. In August 1987 someone overheard the co-worker discussing the substitution and notified police.

Colin Pitchfork was detained on 19 September 1987, and his DNA profile matched. In January 1988 he pleaded guilty and was jailed for life, the first person convicted of murder on the basis of DNA evidence. A tip-off, not the screening, had unmasked him. The test's first beneficiary had been a blameless juvenile who had falsely admitted the offence.
chinese_paragraphs: 1983年11月，一名15岁女孩在莱斯特郡的纳伯勒村遇害，这起凶杀案一直没有侦破。1986年夏天，又一名15岁女孩在邻近的恩德比附近被杀。一名17岁的当地少年供认了第二起命案；在警探们看来，这场令人困惑的调查似乎终于有了结果。
那项关键发现，其实早在两年前就已经出现。1984年9月10日，莱斯特大学遗传学家亚历克·杰弗里斯在一张X光胶片上辨认出一些分子标记，它们的排列在人与人之间差别很大。他把这些标记称为DNA指纹，因为它们和指纹一样，可以区分不同的人。《自然》期刊很快就在1985年3月刊登了他的论文。
警方请来杰弗里斯协助调查，他的基因检测推翻了那份错误供词。那名少年并非行凶者，而两名女孩确实是被同一个人杀害的。少年成为已知第一位凭DNA证据洗清嫌疑的人。在凭这项技术指认任何人涉案之前，这项法医学创新先让一名无辜者重获自由。
1987年1月，警方开始了世界上第一次大规模DNA筛查，请三个村庄的5000多名男子提供血液或唾液样本，结果没有一份吻合。那名难以追查的凶手是一位当地面包师；他事先诱使同事冒用自己的姓名提供样本，从而躲过怀疑。1987年8月，有人无意中听见这名同事谈论冒名顶替的事，便通知了警方。
1987年9月19日，科林·皮奇福克被拘留，他的DNA图谱与案件中的样本吻合。1988年1月，他认罪并被判终身监禁，成为第一位依据DNA证据被判谋杀罪的人。揭开他真面目的，是一条举报线索，而不是那次筛查本身。这项检测最先帮助的，却是一名清白的少年——他曾错误地承认自己犯下了那起罪行。

illustration_prompt:
Create a single publication-quality landscape 3:2 narrative illustration for an adult illustrated English-reading booklet. Finished standalone artwork, not a book mockup, not a collage of multiple unrelated panels. Sophisticated contemporary editorial gouache and watercolor, carefully controlled colored-pencil accents, velvety matte paint, subtle warm paper texture, soft natural daylight. Warm ivory paper dominates; subdued eucalyptus and sage greens structure the composition; restrained buttery lemon-yellow and dusty terracotta accents. Calm, comfortable, refined, credible drawing and natural anatomy. An airy coherent composition with one clear story focal point and at most two supporting details, generous breathing room at all edges and softly feathered painted edges into ivory. Detailed but uncluttered. Historically and scientifically appropriate objects, clothing and setting. Show the particular article's pivotal event or mechanism rather than a generic portrait or generic textbook symbols. Human figures treated with dignity; no grotesque caricature, no sensational violence or visible injuries. For disasters, emphasize the setting, evidence or human response without graphic suffering. For uncertain scientific claims, depict the observations and investigation without presenting debated mechanisms as proven. Absolutely no typography, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, diagram labels, fake writing or invented charts anywhere. Do not render invisible forces as literal magic. Avoid corporate vector icons, slick 3D rendering and childish cartoon style. High-quality, print-ready visual storytelling, matching a warm ivory-and-sage adult watercolor booklet.

ARTICLE 05 — The Fingerprint in the Blood. An early-to-mid-1980s British genetics laboratory. Main focal point: an adult researcher carefully holding a translucent rectangular X-ray autoradiograph up to a simple illuminated viewing box. Show restrained, softly abstract dark band-like traces on the physical film, without any letters, numerals, lane labels or readable analytical chart; the film is a narrative object, not fabricated scientific results identifying a person. The researcher's attentive face is only partly visible in profile; anatomically natural hands and an ordinary unmarked white laboratory coat. A few closed glass sample tubes in a simple rack are the single supporting bench detail. Pale ivory lightbox and paper-like background, sage-gray shadows, tiny restrained terracotta accent. Convey careful comparison of physical evidence, which can rule out a suspect before helping convict another. No crime scene, no victims, no blood splashes, no handcuffs, no police lineup, no giant DNA helix, no modern sequencer screen, no miraculous glowing symbols. Historically plausible quiet laboratory, warm matte gouache-watercolor, uncluttered landscape 3:2 with generous ivory edges.
approved_summary: 杰弗里斯发现DNA标记的排列因人而异，可像指纹一样辨认身份，由此提出DNA指纹。
两名少女遇害后，一名少年供认第二起命案；DNA检验却证明他无辜，并确认两案出自同一凶手。
警方对五千多名男子开展世界首次大规模DNA筛查，却无一吻合；真凶让同事冒名采样，因而漏网。
有人听见同事谈及顶替而举报；警方循线找到皮奇福克，DNA检验确认他是真凶。
少年成为已知首位凭DNA证据获洗冤者；皮奇福克随后认罪、被判终身监禁，成为首位凭DNA证据被判谋杀罪者。
